operations.name: selectNonStoppedSearch
operations.original: SELECT root_invocation FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=? AND task_id=? AND root_invocation=? AND phase<>'STOPPED'
operations.sql: SELECT root_invocation FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND phase<>'STOPPED'

operations.name: selectSearchInvocation
operations.original: SELECT * FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=? AND id=? AND task_id=?
operations.sql: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,step_id,attempt_id,ordinal,slot,provider_id,effect_intent_id,tool,plugin_version,plugin_digest,installation_epoch,input_snapshot,input_digest,state,output_snapshot,output_digest,projection_version,updated_at,record_version,todo_expected_revision,todo_applied_revision,todo_committed_attempt_id,todo_committed_fence,todo_event_seq,todo_committed_at FROM invocation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{invocation} AND task_id=#{task}

operations.name: selectSearchAggregate
operations.original: SELECT COUNT(*) AS roots,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(result_size,4194304)),0) AS bytes FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=? AND task_id=?
operations.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS roots,COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(result_size,4194304)),0) AS bytes FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task}

operations.name: selectSearchWorkerHost
operations.original: SELECT host_id FROM worker_process WHERE id=? AND stopped=FALSE
operations.sql: SELECT host_id FROM worker_process WHERE id=#{worker} AND stopped=FALSE

operations.name: insertSearchRun
operations.original: INSERT INTO native_search_run(tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
operations.sql: INSERT INTO native_search_run(tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin) VALUES(#{tenant},#{invocation},#{task},#{effect},#{attempt},#{worker},#{host},#{directory},#{snapshot},#{digest},#{pin})

operations.name: holdSearchStorage
operations.original: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held+4194304 WHERE tenant_id=?
operations.sql: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held+4194304 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}

operations.name: startSearchRun
operations.original: UPDATE native_search_run SET phase='STARTED',process_identity=? WHERE tenant_id=? AND task_id=? AND root_invocation=? AND attempt_id=? AND phase='PREPARED'
operations.sql: UPDATE native_search_run SET phase='STARTED',process_identity=#{identity} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND phase='PREPARED'

operations.name: selectSearchStopRun
operations.original: SELECT * FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=? AND root_invocation=? AND task_id=? AND effect_id=? AND worker_id=? FOR UPDATE
operations.sql: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND task_id=#{task} AND effect_id=#{effect} AND worker_id=#{worker} FOR UPDATE

operations.name: insertSearchStop
operations.original: INSERT IGNORE INTO native_search_stop(tenant_id,root_invocation,identity_digest,process_identity) VALUES(?,?,?,?)
operations.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO native_search_stop(tenant_id,root_invocation,identity_digest,process_identity) VALUES(#{tenant},#{invocation},#{digest},#{identity})

operations.name: stopSearchRun
operations.original: UPDATE native_search_run SET phase='STOPPED',process_identity=?,stopped_at=COALESCE(stopped_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=? AND root_invocation=?
operations.sql: UPDATE native_search_run SET phase='STOPPED',process_identity=#{identity},stopped_at=COALESCE(stopped_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation}

operations.name: selectSearchCompleteRun
operations.original: SELECT * FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=? AND task_id=? AND root_invocation=? AND attempt_id=? FOR UPDATE
operations.sql: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} FOR UPDATE

operations.name: completeSearchRun
operations.original: UPDATE native_search_run SET result_hash=?,result_size=?,cursor_index=? WHERE tenant_id=? AND root_invocation=?
operations.sql: UPDATE native_search_run SET result_hash=#{hash},result_size=#{size},cursor_index=#{cursors} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation}

operations.name: settleSearchStorage
operations.original: UPDATE reservation SET actual=?,state='SETTLED' WHERE tenant_id=? AND id=? AND category='SEARCH_STORAGE' AND state='RESERVED'
operations.sql: UPDATE reservation SET actual=#{size},state='SETTLED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{reservation} AND category='SEARCH_STORAGE' AND state='RESERVED'

operations.name: releaseCompletedSearchStorage
operations.original: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held-? WHERE tenant_id=?
operations.sql: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held-#{bytes} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}

operations.name: selectSearchPage
operations.original: SELECT * FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=? AND task_id=? AND result_hash IS NOT NULL AND phase='STOPPED' AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
operations.sql: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND result_hash IS NOT NULL AND phase='STOPPED' AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

operations.name: selectNativeSearches
operations.original: SELECT n.*, (t.state<>'RUNNING' OR t.deadline<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR t.lease_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR w.stopped=TRUE) AS stop_requested FROM native_search_run n JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND t.id=n.task_id JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=n.worker_id WHERE n.host_id=? AND n.phase<>'STOPPED' ORDER BY n.root_invocation LIMIT 64
operations.sql: SELECT n.tenant_id,n.root_invocation,n.task_id,n.effect_id,n.attempt_id,n.worker_id,n.host_id,n.runtime_directory,n.snapshot_digest,n.query_digest,n.tool_pin,n.phase,n.process_identity,n.storage_removed,n.result_hash,n.result_size,n.cursor_index,n.created_at,n.stopped_at,n.expires_at,n.record_version, (t.state<>'RUNNING' OR t.deadline<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR t.lease_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR w.stopped=TRUE) AS stop_requested FROM native_search_run n JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND t.id=n.task_id JOIN worker_process w ON w.id=n.worker_id WHERE n.host_id=#{host} AND n.phase<>'STOPPED' ORDER BY n.root_invocation LIMIT 64

operations.name: selectExpiredSearches
operations.original: SELECT n.* FROM native_search_run n JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND t.id=n.task_id WHERE n.host_id=? AND n.phase='STOPPED' AND n.storage_removed=FALSE AND n.expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','NEEDS_RECONCILIATION') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND a.task_id=n.task_id AND a.quiescent=FALSE) LIMIT 64
operations.sql: SELECT n.tenant_id,n.root_invocation,n.task_id,n.effect_id,n.attempt_id,n.worker_id,n.host_id,n.runtime_directory,n.snapshot_digest,n.query_digest,n.tool_pin,n.phase,n.process_identity,n.storage_removed,n.result_hash,n.result_size,n.cursor_index,n.created_at,n.stopped_at,n.expires_at,n.record_version FROM native_search_run n JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND t.id=n.task_id WHERE n.host_id=#{host} AND n.phase='STOPPED' AND n.storage_removed=FALSE AND n.expires_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','NEEDS_RECONCILIATION') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id=n.tenant_id AND a.task_id=n.task_id AND a.quiescent=FALSE) LIMIT 64

operations.name: selectSearchRemovalRun
operations.original: SELECT * FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=? AND root_invocation=? AND task_id=? AND effect_id=? FOR UPDATE
operations.sql: SELECT tenant_id,root_invocation,task_id,effect_id,attempt_id,worker_id,host_id,runtime_directory,snapshot_digest,query_digest,tool_pin,phase,process_identity,storage_removed,result_hash,result_size,cursor_index,created_at,stopped_at,expires_at,record_version FROM native_search_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation} AND task_id=#{task} AND effect_id=#{effect} FOR UPDATE

operations.name: selectSearchRemovalReservation
operations.original: SELECT * FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=? AND id=? AND category='SEARCH_STORAGE' FOR UPDATE
operations.sql: SELECT tenant_id,id,task_id,dispatch_id,category,amount,actual,usage_quality,cost_quality,state,record_version FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{reservation} AND category='SEARCH_STORAGE' FOR UPDATE

operations.name: releaseRemovedSearchStorage
operations.original: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held-? WHERE tenant_id=?
operations.sql: UPDATE tenant_budget SET storage_held=storage_held-#{bytes} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}

operations.name: releaseSearchReservation
operations.original: UPDATE reservation SET state='RELEASED' WHERE tenant_id=? AND id=?
operations.sql: UPDATE reservation SET state='RELEASED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{reservation}

operations.name: removeSearchStorage
operations.original: UPDATE native_search_run SET storage_removed=TRUE,result_size=COALESCE(result_size,0) WHERE tenant_id=? AND root_invocation=?
operations.sql: UPDATE native_search_run SET storage_removed=TRUE,result_size=COALESCE(result_size,0) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND root_invocation=#{invocation}
